svg.text: Where the fault frequencies come from: bearing, gear pair, ducted fan
BPFO = 207.0 Hz: one impact per pass
inner race turns at fs = 33.33 Hz,
the contact angle exists only in this view: it is measured
from the radial plane, so φ = 0 for a deep-groove ball bearing
and φ > 0 for angular-contact and tapered-roller types
GMF = N fs = 28 × 25 = 700 Hz, and a chipped tooth modulates it once per revolution: sidebands at ± fs
mL = nN ± kV = 6 ± 4 → 2 or 10 lobes, turning at nNfs/mL = 175 or 35 Hz: the faster pattern radiates far more strongly
